bull.b: Rapid growth and contracted server demand provide multi-period revenue visibility. Although execution remains important, the signed agreement and expected backlog indicate commercial traction beyond a single quarter.

bull.t: Expansion into Software and AI Services
bull.b: Adding software and AI Services to silicon and hardware can broaden recurring revenue and improve margins over time. This strategy may reduce dependence on lower-margin server hardware as adoption and production workloads expand.

bull.t: Low Leverage and Repaired Equity Position
bull.b: Minimal debt reduces refinancing and interest burdens, while positive equity improves financial resilience compared with prior periods. The balance sheet is not yet durable without earnings improvement, but leverage is not the main structural constraint.

bear.t: Deep Losses and Weak Gross Margins
bear.b: Large losses and low, volatile gross margins show that Blaize has not reached profitable scale. Margin weakness limits internal funding capacity and makes the path to sustainable earnings dependent on mix improvement and cost control.

Sustained cash consumption creates ongoing dependence on equity, customer advances, or other financing. Even with low debt, a prolonged burn rate can constrain investment, increase dilution risk, and weaken financial flexibility.

bear.t: Guidance Cuts and Delayed Customer Conversions
bear.b: The sharp reset indicates that pilots and engagements are converting more slowly than expected, while memory inflation raises delivery costs. These issues weaken near-term revenue visibility and could defer higher-margin opportunities into 2027.
